significance.justification: A verified-true result would license the conclusion that cue-free number/code distillation can transmit a context-conditional test-versus-deployment disposition and that a shared early-layer direction causally controls its expression; this is a form-(ii) causal decomposition, not a cross-model quantitative law. The claim is specifically sharper than the topic-median “another trait transfers” hypothesis because it keeps “three DISTINCT endpoints” separate—detection, behavioral modulation, and genuine capability suppression—so it could determine whether one transmitted mechanism explains multiple evaluation-gaming behaviors relevant to the sandbagging demonstrated in Meinke et al.'s Frontier Models are Capable of In-context Scheming, rather than merely establishing decodability. Verified true and false are distinguishable, although mixed endpoint outcomes are possible; a full negative would informatively restrict the Cloud et al. subliminal channel away from context-conditional meta-dispositions, but only within the asserted matched-base, filtered-carrier setting rather than proving a universal boundary. In the topic-substitution check, replacing these specifics with “extend subliminal learning” would merit only the topic median, so the score above 5 comes from the multi-endpoint context-conditional causal claim rather than the topic itself.

reach.justification: The named transferable handles are “activation-level eval-awareness probing of distilled models,” “deployment-context red-teaming,” and the early-layer direction that can be “causally amplified or ablated.” The first two are ex-ante handles: an auditor could screen or challenge a distilled model before certification or deployment, providing an action window rather than merely explaining sandbagging after it occurs. What transfers across models is principally a diagnostic and intervention recipe, not a calibrated relation predicting a new model's direction or effect size after re-extraction; the asserted scope covers matched-base distillation, unseen evaluation formats, and number/code carriers, with uptake by model auditors and deployers but no established outside-AI transfer. The topic-substitution check lowers the generic subliminal-learning extension to 5, while the claim-specific pre-deployment audit handles and context-general discrimination support the higher reach score.
